drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, en face du théorème, un petit croquis : un arc portant un point épais et deux flèches dans le même sens. On garde $\omega_{\mathfrak{X}}$ puis $\omega_{\mathcal{L}}$ comme sur la page
drawings.kind: arc with a heavy point and two arrows
drawings.notes: A thin arc (pencil-light on its left part, heavy on the right), a heavy point on it, and two arrowheads in the same direction; a small point at the left with the first arrow; a tick at the right end.

drawings.kind: circle x, y with arcs I, J, struck by oblique strokes
drawings.notes: A circle through x (left) and y (right), the upper arc I with an arrowhead towards y, the lower arc J with an arrowhead towards x. Omitted as struck: the four oblique strokes that cross out the whole figure (« figure barrée »); the figure under them is drawn in ink, as the transcription records it.
